solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Run onto main road — a blunder

indicators.note: the run is placed onto the end of the road, so it comes after it

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main motorway north from London, written MI in crosswords
a sprint is a short fast run

explanation.surface: A jogger dashes out onto a busy highway, which is a terrible mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is a British motorway, its 1 read as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: A printing error is a kind of blunder, a careless slip made in typesetting.

clue.text: Bird sanctuary's in Italian city

indicators.note: the sanctuary is placed in the bird's name

parts.note: the moa is an extinct flightless bird of New Zealand
a den is a private sanctuary; the 's is read as 'is'

explanation.surface: A bird reserve is located in an Italian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Modena is a city in northern Italy, home of balsamic vinegar and Ferrari.

clue.text: Look round very fast

indicators.note: the look goes round the other letter

parts.note: to stare is to look fixedly

explanation.surface: Turn and look about you very quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' means go without food, not quick.
explanation.definitionFit: To fast is to go without food, and to starve is to go hungry too.

clue.text: He's got the message

parts.note: in radio talk the word means message received; it is also a man's name, hence He

explanation.walkthrough: Radio operators say this word to confirm a message has been received.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a man's name and the radio reply meaning the message was received.

clue.text: Thoughts of child brought up and given into inner turmoil

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go inner, inside, the reversed piece
in a down answer bringing up means the word is read bottom to top, reversed

parts.note: a son is a child

indicators.note: turmoil is disorder, so the letters of into are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A child's ideas, formed by upbringing and thrown into confusion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' reads as upbringing, but in a down answer it reverses the child; 'turmoil' scrambles 'into', and 'inner' sets that scramble inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Notions are ideas or beliefs, so they are thoughts.

clue.text: Capital in recession had been cold and damp

indicators.note: receding means going backwards, so the letters are read from the end

parts.note: was is the past form of be, close enough to had been here
raw weather is cold and damp

explanation.surface: An economic report: the capital, in a slump, had been chilly and wet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in recession' turns WASRAW back to front; the economic sense is the decoy.
explanation.definitionFit: Warsaw is the capital city of Poland, an example of a capital.

clue.text: That's before we saw the light

definitions.text: That's before we saw the light

parts.words: That's before we saw the light
parts.note: seeing the light here is being born, so this is the stage before birth

explanation.walkthrough: 'saw the light' reads as having a revelation, but here it is first seeing daylight at birth.
explanation.definitionFit: Antenatal describes the period before birth, before a baby first sees daylight.

clue.text: Smart, having knack to be in on the ground floor

indicators.note: the knack is to be put in the other word

parts.note: to smart is to sting
an art is a knack or skill

explanation.surface: A clever person with a knack for getting in early on a venture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smart' looks like an adjective but is the verb, to sting.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in on the ground floor is an idiom for being involved from the beginning, just setting out.

clue.text: Left, having to get towed

parts.note: with means having, as in a man with a hat
drew means pulled or towed

explanation.surface: A broken-down car left, needing to be towed away.
explanation.definitionFit: Withdrew means retreated or went away, so it is a synonym of left.

clue.text: Doctors covering anything which will be taken orally

indicators.note: the doctors cover, that is wrap around, the other piece

parts.note: DRS is the abbreviation for doctors
aught is an old word for anything

explanation.surface: Medics prescribing anything that must be swallowed by mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: Draughts are drinks or doses of medicine, things swallowed by mouth.

clue.text: Passage translated from '27'

indicators.note: translating changes the form of something, so the letters of that answer are rearranged

parts.note: refers to the answer to 27 across, TRAITS

explanation.surface: A passage rendered into English from a numbered text.
explanation.walkthrough: The '27' points to the answer at 27 across, whose letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A strait is a narrow sea channel, a passage between two bodies of water.

clue.text: Herbivores pipe up

indicators.note: in a down answer up means reading from the bottom, reversed

parts.note: a reed is a pipe, a musical reed instrument

explanation.surface: Plant-eating animals start to speak up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pipe up' suggests speaking, but 'pipe' is the reed and 'up' turns it over.
explanation.definitionFit: Deer graze on grass and leaves, so they are plant-eating animals.

clue.text: None — none unaccompanied, that is

definitions.meaning: not any at all, an emphatic nobody
not even one on its own, i.e. not a single one

explanation.surface: A grammatical aside insisting that none means absolutely none.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase splits as never + a one: not even one alone, a single one, which is what 'unaccompanied' adds.
explanation.definitionFit: The emphatic idiom means not even one, an intensified version of nobody.

clue.text: Wrote: 'Yet to reach top in newspaper world'

parts.note: not yet having reached it is not being it, so NOT
the editor, ED, is the top person on a newspaper

explanation.surface: A journalist writes about someone who has not yet climbed to the top of the press.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'not editor': not yet at the top of the newspaper world.
explanation.definitionFit: To note something down is to write it, so jotted equals wrote.

clue.text: This girl making a comeback with us would be a bright star

definitions.text: This girl making a comeback with us would be a bright star

parts.words: This girl making a comeback with us would be a bright star
parts.note: the girl's name reversed is SIRI, and adding US gives SIRIUS, the brightest star in the night sky

explanation.surface: A girl's return to the company would make her a shining star.
explanation.walkthrough: Sirius, the Dog Star, is the brightest star; take away the US and turn the rest around to find the girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue describes a girl's name whose reversal plus US spells a star, a cryptic description.

clue.text: Ruled it in, and sparked things off again

indicators.note: the word it is placed in the other piece

parts.note: a monarch reigned, so ruled

explanation.surface: A dispute in which someone ruled a point admissible and stirred things up again.
explanation.definitionFit: To reignite is to light again, so figuratively to set things off once more.

clue.text: Train has entire derailment going round bend

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go round, enclosing, the bend
a derailed train is thrown into disorder, so the letters of entire are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
a U-bend, so U

explanation.surface: A whole train comes off the rails on a curve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'derailment' rearranges ENTIRE into RETINE, and 'going round' puts it around U. 'Train' is not a railway train but a following.
explanation.definitionFit: A train in this sense is a body of attendants, the followers of an important person.

clue.text: Feisty, tears up diet ordered to follow

indicators.note: the rearranged letters follow the reversed piece
in a down answer up means reversed

parts.note: rips means tears

indicators.note: ordered here means rearranged, so the letters of diet are reorganised

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A spirited person rips up the diet sheet they were ordered to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tears' is the verb to rip, not crying; 'up' reverses it in this down answer, and 'ordered' scrambles 'diet' to come after.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirited means lively and full of fight, a synonym of feisty.

clue.text: False front as a facade? How could you?

indicators.note: a facade is a front covering, so the front word covers the other piece

parts.note: fore is the front
sham means false or fake

explanation.surface: A deceitful front put up as a facade: how could you?
explanation.walkthrough: 'False front' looks like one phrase but splits: 'False' is the sham, and 'front' is the word that, 'as a facade', encloses it.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation is a reproach meaning you ought to be ashamed, just as a scolding question is.

clue.text: Return westbound for trenches to provide cover

indicators.note: the trenches cover, that is enclose, the other piece

parts.note: pits are dug trenches

indicators.note: in an across answer travelling west means right to left, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Soldiers heading back west dig trenches for shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Return' looks like part of the military picture but is the definition; 'westbound' reverses 'for' in this across answer, and 'to provide cover' wraps the trenches around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A return on an investment is the gain it makes, its profit.

clue.text: Loud drunk's arrested and restrained

indicators.note: arrested means caught and held, so the drunk holds the other letter

parts.note: a sot is a drunk; the 's is read as 'has'
F is forte, the musical direction for loud

explanation.surface: A noisy drunk was arrested and held back.
explanation.definitionFit: Soft means gentle or muted, so it is restrained rather than harsh.

clue.text: Only in spirit, avowedly

indicators.note: avowing is declaring out loud, so the word is as spoken, not as written

parts.note: the soul is a person's spirit

explanation.surface: Someone claims to be present only in spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: Sole means single or the one and only, so it is a synonym of only.

clue.text: Not ordinary open country, by the way

indicators.note: by means next to, so the two pieces sit side by side

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
a range is open grazing land

explanation.surface: Wild open land, incidentally, is far from ordinary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by the way' looks like an aside but gives the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Strange means unusual, so it describes something not ordinary.

clue.text: Shoot a line

definitions.meaning: a line of work, one's profession

explanation.walkthrough: 'Shoot a line' is British slang for boasting, a surface that hides the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Career means to rush headlong, and also a person's line of work.

clue.text: Stops cold, then moves very carefully

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
eases means moves gently and carefully

explanation.surface: Someone halts in the cold, then edges forward cautiously.
explanation.definitionFit: To cease is to come to an end, so ceases is a synonym of stops.

clue.text: About southern French nothing's come up

indicators.note: about means around, so the French word goes around the other letter

parts.note: rien is French for nothing; the 's is read as 'has'

explanation.surface: Regarding the South, nothing in French has arisen.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has risen has come up, as the sun or bread dough does.

clue.text: On trees, meant to carve more than an initial

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit on, that is follow, the trees

parts.note: firs are coniferous trees

indicators.note: carving cuts and reshapes, so the letters of meant are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Lovers intending to carve something on the trees, more than just their initials.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meant' is not a verb here but the letters scrambled by 'to carve'; 'On' sets them after the trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Initials are only first letters; the full given name is more than that.

clue.text: With discretion, quash Republican information distributed

indicators.note: squash in: the other letter is pressed into the discretion word

parts.note: tact is discretion

explanation.surface: Discreetly, suppress the leaked Republican material.
explanation.definitionFit: A tract is a pamphlet handed out, so it is information distributed.

clue.text: In spring, backed one evincing these peculiarities

indicators.note: the single letter is put in the reversed word
backed means going backwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: to spring is to start, jump
the numeral one looks like the letter I

explanation.surface: In the spring, someone backed one person showing these odd features.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' turns START into TRATS, and 'In' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Traits are characteristic features, so they are a person's peculiarities.

clue.text: The telltale shoes

definitions.meaning: sneaks, those who tell tales, collectively
soft rubber-soled shoes are also known by this name, trainers

explanation.walkthrough: A sneak is British school slang for someone who tells tales.
explanation.definitionFit: Telltales are sneaks, and soft canvas plimsolls are sneakers in American use.

clue.text: Repressing again parent's fears

indicators.note: the parent's word presses down on, enclosing, the other piece

parts.note: a dad is a parent, so parent's gives DAD'S
re- is the prefix meaning again

explanation.surface: A parent's fears are being suppressed once more.
explanation.definitionFit: To dread something is to fear it greatly, so dreads is a synonym of fears.

clue.text: Films, news reels, for rest to fidget through

indicators.note: the second arrangement goes through, inside, the first
reeling is staggering about, so the letters of news are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: fidgeting is restless moving, so the letters of rest are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: In the cinema, newsreels showing, while someone at rest fidgets through them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'news reels' suggests the cinema newsreel, but 'reels' scrambles 'news'; 'to fidget' scrambles 'rest', and 'through' sets the second scramble inside the first.
explanation.definitionFit: Westerns are films set in the American frontier, a genre of cowboy movie.
